_doc: RevenueCat Web Billing Web Purchase Links (public URLs, docs/33 §9). Empty = the web app and sideload APK show 'Card payments open shortly'. Paste from RevenueCat → Web → Web Purchase Links: 'default' = the link for offering 'default', 'founding' = the link for offering 'founding'. Read by scripts/deploy-web-production.sh and scripts/build-android-apk.sh; an environment variable of the same EXPO_PUBLIC_ name overrides.
